name: OpenJDK
grade_reasons: Many vulnerabilities for its popularity (top 19% of projects with similar GitHub stars)

verified.name: Proofs about it · CWI, TU Darmstadt
verified.what: One-off KeY case studies of JDK classes, none maintained or in CI: TimSort crash bug found and a fixed version verified (CAV 2015); corrected LinkedList verified (2019); IdentityHashMap main insertion/lookup methods proved (FAC 2023), the class as in the latest JDK 7 update and unchanged up to JDK 17; DualPivotQuicksort.sort(int[]) of OpenJDK 8 proved to sort and permute (2017; a loop invariant stated in a source comment does not hold; JDK 14 replaced the code); BitSet: JML specification and proofs of simple methods only (iFM 2023, proof files 2024); BigInteger (OpenJDK 8): 5 methods (2017 thesis)
